svg.text: The FIC_0 bus is 64 bits = two 32-bit lanes. Each lane holds one complex sample.
3 bus cycles -> 3 samples. Half of every beat is dead, on all 2160 beats of the row.
3 bus cycles -> 5 samples. One word is thrown away, ONCE, at the start of the row.
A row is N x 4 bytes with N ODD, so every other row starts halfway through a beat.
Rather than narrow the bus to fit, the gather reads from IN_BASE & ~7 and drops the leading word: the offset moves into the sample INDEX, not the beat width.
n_lo = 2*beat - rd_odd n_hi = n_lo + 1 beats = (SN + rd_odd + 1) >> 1 (rd_odd = IN_BASE[2])
The two lanes also go to SEPARATE banks by sample parity, which is what lets the gather read src[k] and src[k+1] in one cycle from single-port RAM.
Measured: pass 1 5.21 s -> 3.74 s (full-width read plus on-fabric coefficients). Source: sar_resample_v.v:627-696.
